tool.name: ccnv ref-qc
tool.description: Audit an existing ccnv reference Parquet model and emit usability verdicts
tool.command: ln -s '$reference' reference.ccnv && ccnv ref-qc reference.ccnv --prefix out_ref --loglevel '$loglevel'

param.name: reference
param.label: Reference model (.ccnv)
param.help: Existing reference Parquet file generated by ccnv reference.

tool.help:
**What it does**
``ccnv ref-qc`` audits an existing reference Parquet file (``.ccnv``) for unmasked bin counts, off-chromosome Prototype Graph match quality, sex-signal contig representation, and (for prenatal references) prenatal model health.
**Outputs**
- **Reference QC JSON**: Structured audit report containing metrics and ``PASS``, ``WARN``, or ``FAIL`` usability verdicts.
